metrics: QPC wall milliseconds inside native wrapper and QueryThreadCycleTime cycle deltas. Cycle measurement includes the two QPC reads; IO/preparation/CSV formatting excluded.
rotation: Every trial rotates fixture/method order; immediate pairs alternate baseline-first/after-first. Both DLLs loaded together on one calling thread.
interpretation: Offline CPU helper workload; no live A/B, frame jitter, Present, GPU or displayed-adoption measurement. Corrected classification can change work and sample counts; review outcomes alongside timing. Maxima include any host scheduling interference. No timing assertion.
